Description

TLP Receive CSR (PCIe link --> CPU). The first two beats of an incoming TLP are captured as they are: the 3 header DWORDs and the payload DWORD (or DW3 of a 4-DW header). The firmware decodes them, then clears rx.valid to take the next TLP.

Contents

Offset Identifier Name
0x00 header0 csr.rx.header0
0x04 header1 csr.rx.header1
0x08 header2 csr.rx.header2
0x0C data csr.rx.data
0x10 valid csr.rx.valid
